title: nf-core/pdecuration pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the samplesheet provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

assembly.errorMessage: Draft genome assembly FASTA (.fa, .fasta, .fna, optionally .gz) must be provided

bam.errorMessage: Aligned long-read BAM file (.bam) must be provided

bai.errorMessage: BAM index file must have extension .bai or .csi

chromosomes.description: Optional comma- or semicolon-separated list of nuclear chromosome names (e.g. 'I;II;III;IV;V;X')

telomere_repeat.description: Optional per-sample canonical telomere repeat motif override (e.g. 'TTAGGC')
